name: Timurid Painter
findings: Within his own canvases, navy turns up as a small accent in 100% of the paintings that hold it, 5.4x the archive's rate (from 798 paintings here).
Within his own canvases, golden brown turns up as the shadow in 60% of the paintings that hold it, 5.1x the archive's rate (from 798 paintings here).
Rarely uses smoky black, common in the same museum(s)' other paintings (from 798 paintings here).
Rarely uses dark olive brown, common in the same museum(s)' other paintings (from 798 paintings here).
Pairs asphodel green with rinnemann's green more than chance would predict (3 of 798 paintings here).
Pairs primrose yellow with reed yellow more than chance would predict (3 of 798 paintings here).
His single largest palette family (tan, linen grey, olive-buff) covers 62% of his paintings here.
Keeps 2 distinct palette families here, from tan, linen grey to camel, tan.
